items.subject: Ballroom of the Círculo de Bellas Artes in Madrid, Spanish couples in 1961 evening wear: men in dark suits with slicked hair, women in knee-length full-skirted dresses; a young dark-haired Spanish man in his late twenties, slim, meeting a slender Spanish woman in her mid-twenties

items.subject: Newlywed Spanish couple, the man late twenties and lean in a dark suit, the woman mid-twenties in a modest pale wedding dress, a few relatives in sober 1960s Sunday clothes

items.camera_angle: slightly high angle from the church doorway
items.mood: diffuse grey light, rice grains caught mid-air, a quiet small gathering on the steps
items.narration_anchor: Un año después se casan: el jueves veinte de septiembre de mil novecientos sesenta y dos.

items.subject: Hundreds of Spanish emigrants in 1960s travelling clothes, men in caps and jackets, women in headscarves and plain dresses, filling the frame along a passenger liner's rails
items.action: emigrants crowd the gangway and deck as the ship prepares to leave port

items.camera_angle: low angle from the quay up to the deck
items.mood: crisp sunlight, a dense mass of bodies pressed to the rails, gulls overhead
items.narration_anchor: Cuatro días más tarde ya están en el barco. Van a Australia con el acuerdo migratorio por el que pasaron cerca de ocho mil españoles.

items.subject: Young Spanish couple, the man late twenties and wiry in shirtsleeves, the woman mid-twenties in a simple cotton dress, seen from behind
items.action: the couple stands together at the stern rail watching the wake stretch toward an empty horizon

items.props_detail: a single worn leather suitcase at their feet
items.lighting: clear midday sun with long horizon haze
items.mood: vast empty horizon, two small figures leaning into each other against the wind
items.narration_anchor: De Wittenoom no saben nada; saben que hay trabajo y que van juntos.

items.subject: Mid-twenties Spanish woman, slender, dark hair pinned back, simple patterned dress, beside her late-twenties Spanish husband with a weathered face
items.action: she walks pressed tight against her husband's arm along the crowded deck
items.gaze_interaction: her face to the front, chin lifted, eyes forward past the camera; her arm hooked through his

items.color_palette: sun-bleached whites, navy, faded floral cotton, sea blue
items.props_detail: a small handbag clutched against her hip
items.lighting: soft afternoon sun with sea glare
items.mood: warm glare, her body leaning wholly into his side, steady forward stride
items.narration_anchor: «Iba pegadita a mi marido, como una niña», recuerda su mujer.

items.subject: A Madrid family of Spanish emigrants: a sturdy man in his thirties in a flat cap, a woman in her thirties in a headscarf, and their young son
items.action: the family sits together on deck benches among other emigrants during the long crossing
items.gaze_interaction: the parents turned toward each other in conversation, the boy looking out over the rail

items.camera_angle: slightly high angle from an upper deck
items.mood: even hazy light, families clustered close on hard benches, calm swell
items.narration_anchor: Con el tiempo se hicieron amigos íntimos de otra pareja, Milagros Barroso y Ramón de Juan. Esa familia madrileña había hecho el mismo viaje un mes antes.

items.subject: A young Spanish boy about eight, thin, olive-skinned, in short trousers and a sweat-damp short-sleeved shirt
items.action: the boy leans against a sun-hot deck rail, shirt stuck to his back, fanning himself with a cap
items.gaze_interaction: head tilted down from the glare, squinting toward the shimmering water

items.color_palette: bleached white, hot steel grey, pale blue, sun-faded khaki
items.props_detail: a battered cloth cap used as a fan
items.mood: blinding overhead light, damp hair plastered to the forehead, heat shimmer off the steel
items.narration_anchor: Un niño que hizo ese viaje todavía recuerda el calor.

items.subject: A young Spanish boy about eight, slight build, in a buttoned shirt and short trousers, holding his mother's hand among emigrant families
items.action: the boy climbs the steep gangway onto the liner amid a stream of passengers
items.gaze_interaction: seen from behind, head tipped back toward the towering hull
items.setting: Port of Málaga quay in 1962, whitewashed harbour buildings and cranes behind
items.color_palette: Mediterranean white, harbour blue, rust, faded browns
items.props_detail: a small cardboard suitcase bumping against his knees
items.mood: sharp sunlight, a small figure dwarfed by the steel hull, a steady upward stream of bodies
items.narration_anchor: Víctor Calvo era un niño cuando subió a ese barco.

items.subject: A 1960s emigrant passenger liner alone on the open ocean
items.action: the ship ploughs steadily through an endless sea, smoke trailing from its funnel
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction toward the far horizon ahead of the bow

items.color_palette: deep ocean blue, white hull, grey smoke, pale sky
items.props_detail: a long white wake fading behind the stern
items.lens_technique: wide lens, deep depth of field
items.mood: tiny ship in a boundless sea, unbroken horizon in every direction
items.narration_anchor: «Salimos de Málaga y tardamos más de 20 días en llegar en barco a Australia», dice Calvo.

items.subject: An emigrant liner gliding through the Suez Canal, tiny passengers lining the rails
items.action: the ship slides slowly between flat desert banks, heat haze rising off the sand
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction along the straight channel into the shimmering distance
items.setting: Suez Canal in 1962, sandy embankments, a few palms and low mud-brick buildings
items.color_palette: bleached sand, white sky, green-brown canal water, white hull
items.props_detail: heat haze warping the hull's reflection in the canal
items.lens_technique: telephoto compression, deep depth of field
items.mood: oppressive white glare, wavering air, passengers sheltering under deck awnings
items.narration_anchor: Recuerda el canal de Suez y el calor que hacía ahí, un calor que todavía lo hace resoplar cuando lo cuenta.

items.subject: A Spanish emigrant family below deck: a woman in her thirties slumped on a narrow bunk, a young boy about eight curled against her, a man in his thirties sitting hunched on a trunk
items.action: the family rides out a rolling sea, the boy pale and curled, the man staring at the floor
items.gaze_interaction: the woman's head tipped back against the bulkhead, the man looking down, nobody meeting another's eyes
items.setting: Cramped 1960s steerage cabin with steel bunks, rivets and a single porthole
items.color_palette: dim green-grey steel, faded linen, muted browns
items.props_detail: a tin basin sliding on the floor with the roll
items.lighting: low-key light from one round porthole
items.mood: single shaft of grey light, sweat-damp clothes, bodies slack and drained
items.narration_anchor: Recuerda los mareos. Y la incertidumbre: no saber muy bien adónde iban ni cómo iban a vivir.

items.subject: A small 1960s twin-propeller passenger aircraft over the Pilbara
items.action: the plane tilts and bucks through thermal turbulence above the red desert
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction following the plane across vast empty land
items.setting: Sky above the Pilbara desert, Western Australia, 1962, flat-topped red ranges below
items.color_palette: rust red earth, ochre, dusty pale blue sky, silver fuselage
items.props_detail: spinning propellers blurring in the hot air
items.mood: heat-warped air, a tiny aircraft dipping its wing over boundless red land
items.narration_anchor: Después del barco, un avión pequeño, de hélices, que se sacude durante todo el vuelo.

items.subject: A small twin-propeller aircraft touching down on a remote desert airstrip, a few tin sheds beside it
items.action: the plane lands, its wheels throwing up billowing clouds of dust across the strip
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction along the airstrip toward the dust cloud
items.setting: Wittenoom airstrip in the Pilbara desert, 1962, a wooden sign board and a windsock by a corrugated iron shed
items.color_palette: intense red earth, ochre, grey-blue dusty strip surface, pale dusty sky
items.props_detail: a limp windsock beside the corrugated iron shed
items.camera_angle: eye-level from the edge of the strip
items.mood: dust swallowing the wheels, shimmering heat, no shade anywhere

text_in_image.location: on the wooden sign board beside the shed

items.narration_anchor: Aterriza en una pista en medio de una tierra muy roja, en el desierto de Pilbara, en Australia Occidental. Hay polvo por todas partes.

items.subject: Newly arrived Spanish migrant family: a man in his thirties carrying suitcases, a woman in her thirties in a headscarf, and a boy about eight, all dusted red; the active 1962 town of small houses
items.action: the family walks a dusty road toward a row of occupied houses, the boy kicking up powder
items.gaze_interaction: seen from behind, the boy's head turned toward the dust drifting across the road
items.setting: Active Wittenoom township, 1962, small inhabited houses of corrugated iron, wood and asbestos cement sheeting, washing lines, a parked truck, red ranges behind
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, freshly painted grey and cream iron, faint blue-grey on the road surface, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a clothesline of laundry already reddened with dust
items.mood: fine dust hanging in the air, shoes and hems coated red, low houses baking in the heat
items.narration_anchor: Ese niño cuenta que nunca había visto tanto polvo. Los llevan a las casas: chapa, madera y uralita.

items.subject: The blue asbestos tailings at the crocidolite mine in the gorge
items.action: the blue asbestos tailings pour from a loading chute into a waiting ore truck, fine dust lifting off
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction on the dust drifting off the material into the sunlight
items.setting: Wittenoom Gorge mine site, 1962, banded red rock walls and a dusty timber loading chute
items.color_palette: steel blue, rust red rock, ochre, grey dust
items.props_detail: a dented mid-century ore truck tray catching the load
items.lens_technique: macro-leaning 100mm lens, shallow depth of field
items.lighting: harsh afternoon desert sun raking across the gorge
items.mood: glittering fibres suspended in hard light, a constant haze over the rock
items.narration_anchor: De esa tierra sacan crocidolita, el asbesto azul, un mineral que se paga bien porque aguanta el calor y no se gasta.

items.subject: A young Spanish boy about eight, thin, in dusty shorts and a faded shirt, standing in the yard of a small corrugated iron house, his mother in her thirties hanging washing behind
items.action: the boy stands barefoot in the yard as a pale haze of dust drifts in from the mill and settles over everything
items.gaze_interaction: the boy's face to the front, squinting into the drifting haze, the mother turned toward the line
items.setting: Backyard of an inhabited Wittenoom house, 1962, yard ground surfaced with blue-grey tailings, mill stack smoking in the distance
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, blue-grey yard surface, faded cream iron, hazy dusty sky
items.props_detail: a tin toy truck half-buried in the blue-grey yard surface
items.lighting: low golden late-afternoon sun through dust haze
items.mood: amber light thickened by floating dust, skin and hair dulled with powder, an ordinary day under a settling cloud
items.narration_anchor: Nadie les dijo qué era el polvo. La compañía lo sabía desde hacía dieciocho años.
